page.text:
The distinction between free and bound variables is a matter of scope,
not typography. In $P(x)\land\exists x\,Q(x)$, the first occurrence of
$x$ is free and the occurrences governed by $\exists x$ are bound.
Careless substitution can therefore change meaning by variable capture; a
rigorous substitution operation always renames bound variables when
necessary.
